newsitem.title: INDONESIA: United Tractors says hedged on dlr loans.
newsitem.headline: United Tractors says hedged on dlr loans.

text.p: Indonesian heavy equipment distributor and mining contractor PT United Tractors said on Monday that it was naturally hedged on its dollar borrowings since most of its revenues were also denominated in the U.S. currency.
The company said in a statement that its heavy equipment, mining and material handling divisions received revenues in dollars while costs were in rupiah.
"The only rupiah income is from our parts and sales (division)," it said. "As a result, although United Tractors borrows mainly in U.S. dollars, we are naturally hedged."

The rupiah has plunged over 20 percent against the U.S. dollar since the beginning of the year and analysts have said this will sharply affect those Indonesian companies whose foreign currency borrowings are unhedged.
United Tractors earlier said net profit in the first six months of the year rose to 46.5 billion dollars from 32.1 billion dollars in the year-ago period.
It said sales rose 40.6 percent to 1.276 trillion rupiah with contributions from all its divisions.
